description: Volleyball program integrity report - counters + per-work-order notes per PLAN-VB.
method: Per-edition census (official match counts) -> build 100% from cited bytes -> full-harness verification; coverage-build convention (no gap IDs; per-WO closure notes).
wo_vb1_closure_note: WO-VB-1 (2026-08-23, Auditor 1): EuroVolley coverage COMPLETE - 4 editions (W+M 2021, W+M 2023) / 304 matches, all built from cited bytes with unique per-row official CEV sources (2021+W-2023: legacy MatchStatistics URLs wayback-recoverable; M-2023: live cev.eu match-centre URLs). FIDELITY cross-lock held on ALL FOUR editions: per-team pool points recomputed from set tokens == official standings spw/spl for all 96 team-pool entries. Champions: W-2021 Italy, M-2021 Italy (the Italian double), W-2023 Turkiye (1st title), M-2023 Poland. City-by-date venue mappings byte-enforced (Pool B Italy 2023-W: Verona/Monza/Turin; Pool A Italy 2023-M: Bologna/Perugia/Ancona); home flags per Director rule throughout; zero forfeits or golden sets in any of the four editions (verified absence, not assumption - every S-column complete). EuroVolley 2026 W+M enter via WO-VB-8 post-event queue (finals Sep 6 / Sep 26).
wo_vb2_closure_note: WO-VB-2 (2026-08-23, Auditor 1): World Championship coverage COMPLETE - 4 editions (M+W 2022, M+W 2025) / 280 matches from cited bytes with unique per-row LIVE volleyballworld.com sources + FIVB P2 PDFs. FIDELITY locks: 2022-M all 24 teams (+combined-table double-check); 2022-W TRIPLE lock incl. cumulative carry-over standings for all 16 second-phase teams; 2025-M all 32; 2025-W all 32 (via pool-tables template, disclosed). Champions: 2022 Italy(M)/Serbia(W); 2025 Italy(M)+Italy(W) - the Italian double, first since USSR. Format epochs preserved: 24-team six-pool (2022-M), 24-team two-phase carry-over (2022-W), 32-team biennial debut (2025 both). Host history: 2022-M stripped from Russia; 2022-W Russia removed/Croatia invited; 2025 first SE-Asia editions. Store-record sets: BUL-GER 40-38 (2025-M), ITA-CAN 39-37 (2022-M), BRA-FRA 33-31 (2025-W). Zero forfeits/golden sets across all four (verified absence). 2027 'World Cup' rename noted for the WO-VB-8-era successor censuses.
